scope: PlayUZU Spain progressive network candidates discovered from official structured jackpot data
purpose: Measure state evolution and resets without converting jackpot size alone into an economic claim.

qualifyingEvidence: same exact raw jackpot counter observed on at least two distinct validated titles in one official snapshot
or explicit operator/provider documentation identifying a shared progressive network

observation.resetDefinition: rawNetworkCounter lower than immediately prior valid observation

requiredBeforeAnyPositiveEVCalculation: exact or independently estimable progressive contribution per eligible stake
exact or independently estimable jackpot trigger probability or equivalent payout incidence
currency/localization mapping if counter is monetary
base-game RTP for the exact configuration
proof that jackpot eligibility is included in the modeled stake
requiredBeforePromotion: positive conservative expected value after all known costs
